## Originality / provenance

- [ ] This change was implemented from KING requirements, an ADR, a public standard, a documented bug/security finding, or another recorded internal requirement.
- [ ] I did not copy third-party source code, prompts, UI, documentation text, proprietary schemas, or distinctive implementation structure into KINGAIBOT.

- [ ] Any required third-party notices/attribution are retained.
- [ ] If this implements an external protocol, the protocol is treated as a compatibility boundary and KINGAIBOT retains its own internal model.
